name: paperlib
title: Paperlib
description: Search your Paperlib library and copy DOI, citation, or BibTeX.
author: jialinli

commands.name: search-papers
commands.title: Search Papers
commands.subtitle: Paperlib
commands.description: Search the local Paperlib library and copy DOI, citation, or BibTeX.

preferences.name: apiHost
preferences.title: Paperlib API Host
preferences.description: HTTP endpoint exposed by @future-scholars/paperlib-apihost-extension. Paperlib must be running.

preferences.name: localLibraryFile
preferences.title: Library JSON or CSV
preferences.description: Optional export used when the API Host is unavailable. Accepts Paperlib CSV or a JSON array of paper records.

preferences.name: libraryFolder
preferences.title: Paperlib Library Folder
preferences.description: Folder that contains library.json, papers.csv, or default.realm. Defaults to ~/Documents/paperlib.

preferences.name: useDemoFallback
preferences.label: Use demo library when Paperlib is offline
preferences.description: Load a small built-in sample library so search still works in CI and first-run demos.

preferences.name: fetchRemoteAbstracts
preferences.label: Fetch abstracts from Crossref or arXiv
preferences.description: Paperlib does not store abstracts on paper records. When enabled, missing abstracts are filled from Crossref or arXiv.

preferences.name: citationStyle
preferences.title: Citation style
preferences.description: Plain-text citation format copied from Search Papers. Matches Paperlib's built-in APA-style export by default.

preferences.name: resultLimit
preferences.title: Result limit
preferences.description: Maximum number of papers to load from Paperlib.
